profile_text: As a leading provider of online job boards and recruitment solutions, this company connects employers with job seekers, driving growth through its innovative digital platforms. With a 69.2% increase in employees since its baseline, the company's success is attributed to its ability to effectively match candidates with job openings, catering to the evolving needs of the job market. Operating in the information and communication sector, it has established itself as a key player in the recruitment industry, with 330 employees as of 2024.
